services.name: Fun in the Sun Tour
services.desc: Your Best Day of Vacation! About This is our "open itinerary " trip. We decide on the route on the day of the trip based on weather, tides, and your mood. Available from both marinas on board the "Dolphin Dancer". 1/2 Day Trip | 4 Hours | $595 We cruise out to one of several beautiful beaches where we anchor up for some shelling, relaxing on the beach, and enjoying the water. This trip includes the dolphin tour and island history narrative to and from the beach stop. Bring your picnic lunch and beverages and enjoy the day. 3/4 Day Trip | 6 Hours| $795.00 All of the above and more, plus time All ages • up to 6 guests • 4, 6, or 8 hrs • Your best day of vacation!

services.name: Burial at Sea
services.desc: 1.5 - 2 Hour Trip 2.5 - 3 Hour Trip Ceremony Details We run to the legal zone ( at least 3 miles offshore) in the direction of your choice within time limit. You may depart from our Fort Myers or Bonita Springs location. We will then drift over the memorial site and disperse the ashes with a short ceremony. We record and supply you GPS #s along with longitude and latitude for your recording with EPA. Please Note: weather and wind can cause the sea to make the boat rock.
